summary: SKOPPUM HOLDING AS (org. no. 887 922 012) is a private limited company (AS) based in Horten, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2005-02-26. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 29.320 (Produksjon av andre deler og annet utstyr til motorvogner); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) net income was NOK 2.4 m. CEO: Jan Arild Haugstulen; board chair: Kjell Magne Baksaas; auditor: REVISJONSFIRMAET HOTVEDT & CO AS.
